text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to the studio together with 
Lucky Lilac for a certain photoshoot...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm Lucky Lilac. Pleased to be working 
with you today.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you for having us~! There's 
still some time before the real deal, so 
please relax in the green room and wait, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, what's the matter? You seem 
awfully nervous..."
choice_data_list:
Ahaha, doing a formal photoshoot feels a 
bit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Today's photo shoot was for a special 
feature titled 'The "Queen" Lucky Lilac 
and Her Trainer,' where the two of us were 
to be photographed side by side."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've stood beside her in public many 
times. Yet, when it comes to having our 
photos taken just for the sake of it, I 
find myself feeling a bit nervous...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Doing things your usual way is completely 
fine. Don't tense up, just take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Hmm, her expression's still kinda stiff~ 
Unlike being on the track or at the 
academy, maybe the whole "official photo 
shoot!" vibe is makin' her nervous.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(If only I could somehow create an 
atmosphere that makes things easier for 
Trainer――)

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Lucky Lilac-san, Trainer-san. Thank you 
for waiting! Everything is ready for the 
shoot, so right this way!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Alright. Let's give it a shot, shall 
we?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Um, if I remember correctly, for today's 
shoot, we're using some props too, right?

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We have various things prepared over 
there, so if anything catches your eye, 
please let us know during the photoshoot!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. In that case, would 
it be alright if I used the tools a bit to 
get used to them before the shoot?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Let's double-check our standing 
positions for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. It's pretty neat how legit this 
mic looks.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Please, come over here.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“—Yeah, stand right there. Maybe a little 
further back? Right alongside me.”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that sounds fine.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mr. Cameraman. How do we look 
standing side-by-side like this?

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
That's pretty fresh! With the two of you 
standing in front of the mic, you look 
just like a comedy duo!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I saw this mic earlier and really 
wanted to give it a try. Pretty amusing, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —...Trainer-san. We're a duo, after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No matter the time, we always stand side 
by side, sharing the exact same things.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Please don't forget that this is one of 
the pillars keeping me going."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash!)

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Both of you had such wonderful 
expressions that I couldn't help snapping 
a photo...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Pay it no mind. I'm just glad to see you 
looking like your usual self again.
choice_data_list: Thank you, Luck. I'm okay now.
Thank you, Luck. I'm okay now.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. How lovely.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Mr. Photographer. We're done 
warming up, so let's start the shoot 
again.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After that, thanks to Lucky Lilac, I 
was able to face the rest of the 
photoshoot with confidence—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(That photo I took with Trainer in front 
of the mic. They ended up not using it in 
this feature, but they were kind enough to 
share the data with me...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Settin' it as my home screen would be 
takin' it too far, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah well. Guess I'll just keep hold of 
it quietly.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Let's keep it a "Queen's" secret—)
